Pydantic AI executes tool batches from a single model response concurrently, allowing the model to defer all record_criterion_verdict calls until after the budget is exhausted.
Prompt-only instructions cannot enforce one governed repository action per response; system-level finite-loop enforcement at the tool-wrapper seam is required.

The completion-tool-policy wrapper must claim at most one governed action per run_step, count unique evidence responses per criterion, and invoke a fail-closed met=false bank on the third evidence response if still unbanked.
